assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production background image for a carousel option card on an enterprise S3 Object Storage website, not a website mockup. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, high resolution. Premium restrained 3D studio render, realistic matte cobalt metal and frosted glass, midnight navy #061526 background, InterData blue #0066ED with subtle cyan #3FBFFF rim lighting. Match a sophisticated blue object-storage bucket hero illustration, not cartoon clip art or generic server stock photography. Composition is critical: show a compact coherent focal group in the UPPER CENTER, centered horizontally, main subject within the central 35 percent of image width so it survives portrait crops. Keep all crucial content between 8 and 48 percent of image height; the LOWER 45 percent is quiet very dark navy negative space because real white heading, description and button will be overlaid there. Clear legible silhouette, soft depth, subtle floor reflections, calm enterprise art direction. No readable text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no AWS branding, no watermarks, no people, no baked-in UI buttons. Opaque full-bleed background. Specific subject: APPLICATION AND MEDIA object storage. A compact cobalt blue digital storage bucket with an oval open top sits in the upper-center foreground. Above it floats a small curated fan of frosted glass media tiles: a beautiful landscape-photo pictogram, a video play pictogram and a document pictogram. Two small abstract application panels and a simplified smartphone silhouette flank the bucket closely, connected by thin deliberate cyan data paths, communicating that application files and multimedia are stored independently and served to applications. The media tiles must be the distinctive motif. No real screen text, no racks, no household bucket handles, no trash or water. Keep the bucket and media group compact with generous dark space below.
